items.titleZh: F1 2026阿塞拜疆大奖赛练习赛成绩
items.summaryZh: F1在巴库重启，各队带来大幅升级套件，练习赛至关重要。乔治·拉塞尔在FP1和FP2均排名第一。
items.originalTitle: F1 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix practice results
items.summaryEn: F1 is back in action in Baku, and practice is vital this weekend with so many teams bringing well-sized upgrade packages in a bid to move forward. George Russell topped both FP1 and FP2.
detailZh: F1在巴库重启，本周末练习赛至关重要，因为许多车队都带来了大幅升级套件，以期取得进步。

keyPointsZh: FP2中拉塞尔以1分43.347秒居首，安东内利落后0.552秒第二，维斯塔潘落后0.827秒第三。
FP1中拉塞尔以1分45.387秒最快，维斯塔潘落后0.400秒第二，勒克莱尔落后0.404秒第三。
FP2排名第四至第十依次为勒克莱尔、汉密尔顿、诺里斯、加斯利、皮亚斯特里、哈贾尔、奥康。
keyPointsEn: In FP2, Russell topped with 1m43.347s, Antonelli was second (+0.552s) and Verstappen third (+0.827s).
In FP1, Russell was fastest with 1m45.387s, Verstappen second (+0.400s) and Leclerc third (+0.404s).
FP2 positions fourth through tenth were Leclerc, Hamilton, Norris, Gasly, Piastri, Hadjar and Ocon.
